title: Single Containment Control Volume Steam Blowdown
description: Single-volume pressurized containment thermal-hydraulic response with a concrete containment wall heat structure and ambient heat sink.
code:
! Single Containment Control Volume Steam Blowdown
MELGEN_INPUT
TITLE 'Single Containment Control Volume Steam Blowdown'

EXEC_INPUT
  EXEC_TSTART 0.0
  EXEC_TEND 60.0
  EXEC_DT 0.05 1.0 1.0e-5

CVH_INPUT
  CV_ID 'Containment_Dome' 100 NORMAL
  CV_THR 3.5e5 410.0 0.05 0.95
  CV_PAS 45000.0 0.0 42.0
  CV_NCG 'N2' 0.45

  CV_ID 'Environment' 900 NORMAL
  CV_THR 1.01325e5 298.0 0.0 0.01
  CV_PAS 1.0e9 0.0 50.0
  CV_NCG 'N2' 0.79

HS_INPUT
  HS_ID 'Containment_Wall' 101 CYLINDRICAL
  HS_GD 1.2 4200.0 210000.0 1.8 880.0 2400.0
  HS_LB 100 350.0
  HS_RB 900 15.0
  HS_TEMP 315.0
  HS_SRC 0.0

END

title: Core Heat Structure Decay Heat and Boil-Off
description: Reactor pressure vessel core boil-off driven by tabular ANS decay heat power curve with Zircaloy oxidation model and steam relief to containment.
code:
! Core Heat Structure Decay Heat and Boil-Off
MELGEN_INPUT
TITLE 'PWR Core Decay Heat Boil-Off Transient'

EXEC_INPUT
  EXEC_TSTART 0.0
  EXEC_TEND 300.0
  EXEC_DT 0.05 1.0 1.0e-5

CVH_INPUT
  CV_ID 'Reactor_Vessel' 100 NORMAL
  CV_THR 7.5e6 565.0 0.55 0.45
  CV_PAS 110.0 0.0 12.5

  CV_ID 'Pressurizer_Relief' 200 NORMAL
  CV_THR 1.2e5 330.0 0.05 0.20
  CV_PAS 42000.0 0.0 45.0
  CV_NCG 'N2' 0.75

FL_INPUT
  FL_ID 'PORV_Discharge' 10
  FL_FT 100 200 11.5 15.0
  FL_GEO 0.015 3.0 1.0
  FL_USL 2.5 2.5
  FL_IC 0.0

HS_INPUT
  HS_ID 'RPV_Steel_Wall' 1001 CYLINDRICAL
  HS_GD 0.22 145.0 215000.0 34.0 520.0 7850.0
  HS_LB 100 2500.0
  HS_RB 200 40.0
  HS_TEMP 560.0
  HS_SRC 0.0

COR_INPUT
  COR_RP 4 8 2.8e9
  COR_ZDF 88000.0 320.0 580.0 4500.0 20500.0 100
  COR_PWR 2.8e7 2.8e9
  COR_OX ON URBANIC_HEIDRICK 4500.0 20500.0

TF_INPUT
  TF_ID 'ANS_Decay_Curve' 10 1.0 0.0
  TF_TAB 0.0 1.0 60.0 0.72 300.0 0.48 1800.0 0.28

MP_INPUT
  MP_ID 'UO2_Cp' 1 UO2 CP 315.0

END
